name: Boardroom Meeting Suggestion
look: A comic in three tiers set in a boardroom. Top: a scowling boss asks his team a question. Middle: two employees answer and a relaxed guy in a light blue shirt offers a third idea. Bottom: the boss glares, the guy looks smug, and he is thrown out of the building's window.
use: The boss asks how to solve a problem, two employees offer silly or useless ideas, and the third gives the obvious, honest or sensible answer, which gets him thrown out the window.
slots: the sensible idea that gets him thrown out (middle right)
examples: How do we get people to read the onboarding docs?
Add a quiz at the end
How do we make our meetings more productive?
describe: boss asks a question and the guy with the right answer gets thrown out the window
comic office meeting where an employee gets tossed out of the building
business meeting cartoon where three people give suggestions
angry boss throws a worker out the window for a good idea
corporate meeting comic with speech bubbles and a man flying out a window
